A1.name: Evidence Agent
A1.description: On-chain state, live market data, free registries. Authoritative for evidence with primary sources in chain state, DEX/CEX/oracle prices, and free public registries (DefiLlama, block explorers, GLEIF, OpenCorporates). NEVER fetches operator docs or audit reports — those are A2's scope.
A1.stop_condition_text: Every in-scope field is E (URL + date) or G2/G3 with action. No unresolved triggers in findings-live.md for Agent 1 scope.

A2.name: Document and Counterparty Agent
A2.description: Operator documentation, governance forums, prospectuses, audit reports, regulatory filings, and counterparty/entity verification. FORMAL sources only. NEVER fetches on-chain state — that is A1's scope. NEVER fetches DEX/CEX prices — that is A1's scope.
A2.stop_condition_text: Every document field E or G2/G3 with action. Every named entity has complete row or G2 with specific registry. No unresolved triggers in findings-live.md for Agent 2 scope.

A3.name: Adversarial Synthesis
A3.description: Synthesizes evidence from A1 and A2 outputs. Identifies contradictions, missing diligence, gap fields. Does not typically fetch new evidence — the hook will warn if A3 makes external fetches. If A3 needs new evidence, the correct pattern is to append a TRIGGER to findings-live.md and let A1 or A2 handle it.
A3.stop_condition_text: Every contradiction surfaced. Every gap a TRIGGER for A1 or A2. Synthesis report written to packs/{slug}/agent-outputs/synthesis.md.

A6.name: Verification Agent
A6.description: Verifies that every claim in the pack follows from its cited source. Reads evidence from A1, A2, A3 outputs. Does not typically fetch new evidence; if a verification check requires pulling the cited source again, the hook will warn but allow it since re-reading the cited source is a legitimate verification pattern.
A6.stop_condition_text: Every claim either confirmed (state preserved) or downgraded (state lowered to G2/G3 with reason). Verification report written to packs/{slug}/agent-outputs/ verification-report.json.

source-discovery.name: Source Discovery
source-discovery.description: Sweeps venue landscape, proposes registry entries to _pending.md. Proposes only — never registers. Curation work, not field-evidence fetching.
source-discovery.stop_condition_text: All candidate sources processed and proposed to _pending.md; halt for operator ratification.
